votes.motion: Commissioner Nixon moved to APPROVE the Planning Commission Minutes for August 24, 2023
Commissioner Ogden moved to APPROVE the Planning Commission Minutes for September 14, 2023

Commissioner Fowler moved to FORWARD A POSITIVE RECOMMENDATION to the City Council for the proposed Land Use Map Amendment, as requested by Bill Gould, representing Concord Properties and TETS, LLC, for Application 2023-4554-MA based on the following findings: 1. The proposed amendment is consistent with the goals, objectives, and policies of the City’s General Plan. 2. The proposed amendment is harmonious with the overall character of existing development in the vicinity of the subject property. 3. The proposed amendment is consistent with the standards of any applicable overlay zone

Commissioner Ogden moved to FORWARD A POSITIVE RECOMMENDATION to the City Council for the proposed Zoning Map Amendment, as requested by Bill Gould, representing Concord Properties and TETS, LLC, for Application 2023-4558-MA, based on the following findings: 1. The proposed amendment is consistent with the goals, objectives, and policies of the City’s General Plan. 2. The proposed amendment is harmonious with the overall character of existing development in the vicinity of the subject property. 3. The proposed amendment is consistent with the standards of any applicable overlay zone
Commissioner Ogden moved to ADJOURN. Vote: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission. The meeting adjourned at 6:46 PM
